about: WoW Forever (1.60.1.70959) boat/zeppelin/skyship schedules. Times are seconds within one cycle; t=0 is the boat arriving at stops[0]. Phase (where in the cycle the boat is right now) is NOT in the game data: anchor it once from an observation (ride, dock NPC announcement, map change), then now_offset = (GetServerTime() - anchor_time + anchor_offset) % cycle_s.
sources: Forever client tables via wago.tools build 1.60.1.70959: TaxiPath, TaxiPathNode, UiMap, UiMapAssignment, AreaTable, Map
Timing model: port of TrinityCore TransportMgr::GeneratePath / Transport::CalculateSegmentPos, catmull-rom arc lengths
moveSpeed 30 / accelRate 1 and path ids from MaNGOS-zero gameobject_template (type 15); MaNGOS-zero transports.period for comparison
Measured round trips: NauticusClassicResurrected data.lua rtts/rtts_forever (MIT, github.com/sam-k-taylor/NauticusClassicResurrected); Azeroth Tripview CurseForge page (round trips m:ss)
coords: world x = TaxiPathNode Loc_0 (north+), y = Loc_1 (west+); UnitPosition('player') returns (x, y, z, instanceID) in this order. Zone map coords: map_x = (maxY - y)/(maxY - minY), map_y = (maxX - x)/(maxX - minX) using uimaps[] rects.

routes.name: Skywatcher Plateau (Mulgore) - Zephras Isle (Windshapers Dock)
routes.track_note: boat position every 5 s of path time while moving (model); a passenger stands up to ~25 yd from it
routes.note: Model gives 339.67 s but Nauticus measured 347 s three times (zero variance). The path has two map changes with fade events (104400/104401) and flag-8 nodes the model does not understand; the missing 7.3 s is assigned half to each off-screen map change (guess). Arrive/depart offsets of the far dock may be off by up to ~8 s; the cycle itself is measured. Dock NPC 'Windshapers Dockmaster' announces arrivals (text contains 'Skycutter').
